# Moldova

[global-law](../) / Moldova

2 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 1 legislation, subdivisions). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 0% | 0% | 100% | 0% |

Almost nothing of Moldova's national law is held: moldova-law contains only the Constitution (3 versions, its text matching the official 2024 Moldpres edition), and none of the codes, ordinary laws or case law. The Gagauzia repository holds 229 of the autonomy's laws, each only as adopted and dated by its adoption day, and some files are split wrongly (an amending law's operative text filed under the wrong article, and in 44 of 229 laws an explanatory note filed as the signature). Transnistria is outside Moldova's control and has no repository.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
